Chief_Complaint.content: Patient reports not feeling very well for 4–5 days.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: CC: “Not feeling very well” x 4–5 days

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient feels run-down with cough and cold symptoms.
Cough is mostly dry, worse in the morning, with some phlegm.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Cough: mostly dry; worse in AM; some phlegm

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has rhinorrhea described as sniffles.
Patient reports ears feel a little dull or blocked with baseline decreased hearing.
Patient reports shortness of breath and denies chest pain.
Patient feels hot, cold, and sweaty at night and has not measured temperature due to no thermometer.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Feels hot/cold/sweaty at night; no measured temp (no thermometer)

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient had mild diarrhea on day 1 which has now resolved and denies nausea, vomiting, and abdominal pain.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: GI: mild diarrhea day 1, now resolved; denies N/V/abd pain

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Appetite is okay and patient is drinking fluids.
Patient reports myalgias, arthralgias, and stiffness all over, especially in elbows and knees.
Symptom onset was Saturday and today is Wednesday.
No trigger for symptoms has been identified.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient has diabetes mellitus and states it is type one.
Patient has a history of hypertension and was told blood pressure is high.
Patient is overweight and describes self as on the chunky side.

Medications.content: Delayed antibiotic prescription for amoxicillin 1 tablet three times daily if not improving.
Medications.source_text: Delayed abx rx: amoxicillin 1 tab TID

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient lives with wife and children are grown.
Patient works in a factory manufacturing steel parts.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Works in factory manufacturing steel parts

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient drinks approximately 9 pints of alcohol per week.
Patient smokes intermittent cigarettes, uses a vape, and is trying to cut down.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Tobacco: intermittent cigarettes; using vape; trying to cut down

Assessment.content: Viral upper respiratory infection or influenza-like illness for 4–5 days with cough, rhinorrhea, sore throat, fevers, chills, sweats, myalgias, and shortness of breath without chest pain.
Assessment.source_text: 1. Viral URI / influenza-like illness x 4–5 days w/ cough, rhinorrhea, sore throat, fevers/chills/sweats, myalgias; SOB; no CP.

Assessment.content: Shortness of breath in the setting of viral illness without clear chest infection per clinician.
Assessment.source_text: 2. SOB in setting of above; no clear chest infection per clinician.

Assessment.content: Tobacco use with attempt at cessation via vaping.

Plan_of_Care.content: For viral illness or upper respiratory infection, patient is advised to rest and drink oral fluids.
Patient is advised to take paracetamol regularly for hot and cold sweats.
Delayed antibiotic prescription of amoxicillin 1 tablet three times daily for possible bacterial lower respiratory tract infection if not improving.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Delayed abx rx: amoxicillin 1 tab TID

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient should start amoxicillin in 24–48 hours if still breathless, run-down, or not improving.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Start in 24–48 hrs if still breathless/run-down/not improving

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient is encouraged to continue efforts at smoking cessation and cutting down.

Follow_up_Information.content: If not better by next week, patient should follow up for reassessment.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: If not better by next week: f/u for reassessment

Physical_Findings.content: On phone assessment, patient has audible sniffles.
